summary_en: SEED will cancel all treasury shares held as of December 22, 2026, contingent on shareholder approval of a planned stock split with an effective date of December 23, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: SEED's board of directors resolved on November 5, 2026 to cancel all treasury shares held by the company as of December 22, 2026. As of September 30, 2026, SEED held 136 treasury shares out of 30,265,922 total issued shares (0.0% of outstanding shares after treasury stock deduction). The cancellation is contingent upon shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for December 2, 2026 of a stock split proposal with an effective date of December 23, 2026, which was disclosed separately on the same date.
